I have built the complete, native iOS and iPadOS **Storybook Nursery Rhymes** SwiftUI application along with an interactive live web preview.

You can interactively test and explore the app right now in your browser:
👉 **[Open Interactive Live Preview](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/98ca8965-9e9a-434a-889c-cde66cde4b16/e7233fe9a0df54b5a3e1dc70/)**

### 1. Supplied Files & Asset Inventory

* **Supplied Reference**: The project repository contained [`reference_image.png`](file:///home/agent/workspace/reference_image.png) (1536 × 1024 px), depicting the 3 target screens: **Home**, **Explore Rhymes (Library)**, and **Rhyme Player**. No external ZIP file or pre-existing Xcode project was bundled.
* **Component Extraction**: Extracted and processed original, crisp storybook assets:
  * Hero meadow illustration: [`hero_girl_puppy.png`](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/ui/hero_girl_puppy.png) (girl with pink bow, puppy, rainbow, flower meadow).
  * Brand logo: [`logo_nursery_rhymes.png`](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/ui/logo_nursery_rhymes.png) (bubbly typography with smiling star mascot).
  * High-resolution player artwork: [`twinkle_twinkle_full.png`](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/rhymes/twinkle_twinkle_full.png) (midnight starry sky, smiling star, crescent moon, dreamy clouds).
  * Individual library card artworks for the featured reference rhymes: *Twinkle Twinkle Little Star*, *Baa Baa Black Sheep*, *Humpty Dumpty*, *Jack and Jill*, *Row Your Boat*, and *Old MacDonald Had a Farm*.
  * Storyboard honey-wood panels: [`wood_header_library.png`](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/ui/wood_header_library.png) and [`wood_player_tray.png`](file:///home/agent/workspace/assets/ui/wood_player_tray.png).
* **Complete 50-Rhyme Artwork**: Created Retina storybook artwork for all remaining 44 rhymes matching the exact palette (golden stars, rolling hills, daisy flowers, warm ivory, sky blue, soft violet).
* **Audio Media Inventory**: Synthesized 5 royalty-free acoustic music box melodies with accurate notes and durations (*Twinkle Twinkle*, *Baa Baa Black Sheep*, *Row Your Boat*, *Old MacDonald*, *Hush Little Baby*). For the remaining 45 rhymes, the app displays an honest **"Audio not added yet • In checklist"** state, documented in [`MEDIA_CHECKLIST.md`](file:///home/agent/workspace/MEDIA_CHECKLIST.md).

---

### 2. Architecture & Code Structure

The native Swift codebase is organized with clear separation between models, services, presentation, and design tokens:

```
NurseryRhymes/
├── NurseryRhymes.xcodeproj/       # Xcode project with complete PBX configurations
└── NurseryRhymes/
    ├── App/
    │   └── NurseryRhymesApp.swift   # Main SwiftUI application entry point
    ├── Models/
    │   ├── Rhyme.swift              # Rhyme model (Identifiable, Codable, Equatable)
    │   ├── RhymeCategory.swift      # All, Animals, Bedtime, Action & Movement, Playful
    │   ├── LyricSegment.swift       # Timed lyrics model for synchronized karaoke playback
    │   └── AppSettings.swift        # User preferences (autoplay, repeat, reduce motion)
    ├── Services/
    │   ├── RhymeCatalog.swift       # 50-rhyme catalog, search filtering, offline fallback
    │   ├── FavoritesStore.swift     # Persistent favorites (UserDefaults) with queue support
    │   └── PlaybackController.swift # AVFoundation audio player, route changes, interruptions
    ├── Theme/
    │   └── AppTheme.swift           # Storyboard color tokens, gradients, shadows, corner radii
    ├── Components/
    │   ├── WoodenHeader.swift       # Honey-wood plank header with back and favorite buttons
    │   ├── WoodenPlaybackControls.swift # Honey-wood playback tray (prev, play/pause, next, repeat)
    │   ├── RhymeCardView.swift      # Card with heart toggle and bright green play button
    │   ├── BottomNavigationBar.swift# Floating ivory dock with sky-blue active indicator
    │   ├── AudioProgressSlider.swift# Interactive scrubber track, elapsed time & duration
    │   └── RoundIconButton.swift    # 3D jelly push buttons with tactile spring animation
    ├── Views/
    │   ├── MainTabView.swift        # Root container coordinating tabs and player overlay
    │   ├── HomeView.swift           # Screen 1: Branding, settings, hero artwork, favorites row
    │   ├── LibraryView.swift        # Screen 2: "Explore Rhymes", search bar, category chips, grid
    │   ├── PlayerView.swift         # Screen 3: Large artwork, lyrics, mode tabs, playback controls
    │   ├── FavoritesView.swift      # Saved favorites queue with empty state
    │   └── SettingsView.swift       # Playback preferences, reduce motion, reset favorites
    ├── Resources/
    │   ├── rhymes_data.json         # Complete 50-rhyme manifest
    │   └── *.wav                    # Bundled royalty-free music box audio files
    ├── Assets.xcassets/             # Image asset sets for all 50 rhymes and UI components
    └── Info.plist                   # Audio background mode and orientations
```

---

### 3. Screen Implementations

#### Screen 1: Home ([`HomeView.swift`](file:///home/agent/workspace/NurseryRhymes/NurseryRhymes/Views/HomeView.swift))
* Top header with bubbly "Nursery Rhymes" branding, smiling golden star, and purple settings button.
* Large storybook illustration featuring the girl, puppy, and rainbow meadow.
* Cloud banner reading **"Sing, play & discover"** with smiling stars.
* Prominent bright green **"Start Singing"** CTA button that resumes the last played rhyme or opens the library.
* **"Your favorites"** section displaying *Twinkle Twinkle Little Star* and *Baa Baa Black Sheep* cards (or friendly empty state if cleared).
* Floating ivory dock with **Home**, **Rhymes**, and **Favorites** tabs.

#### Screen 2: Explore Rhymes Library ([`LibraryView.swift`](file:///home/agent/workspace/NurseryRhymes/NurseryRhymes/Views/LibraryView.swift))
* Honey-wood header titled **"Explore Rhymes"** with pink circular back button.
* White pill search input with placeholder *"Find a rhyme"* and instant clear button.
* Category filter chips: **All** (bright green when active), **Animals**, **Bedtime**, **Action & Movement**, and **Playful**.
* Adaptive grid: 2 columns on iPhone, 4 columns on iPad.
* Native interactive cards:
  * Top-right heart button toggles favorite state across all screens with haptic/spring feedback.
  * Bottom-center bright green circular button controls playback.
  * Tapping the card opens the full player.
* Empty search results state with a **"Clear Filters"** button.

#### Screen 3: Rhyme Player ([`PlayerView.swift`](file:///home/agent/workspace/NurseryRhymes/NurseryRhymes/Views/PlayerView.swift))
* Honey-wood header with pink back button, rhyme title, and pink favorite heart button.
* Large rounded storybook artwork area (with honest missing audio indicator when audio is not yet added).
* Full rhyme title in dark navy rounded typography.
* Lyrics preview: *"Twinkle, twinkle, little star / How I wonder what you are"*.
* Segmented mode tabs: **Watch** (sky-blue active pill) and **Lyrics** (full scrollable lyrics view).
* Real elapsed time, scrubber track, and duration.
* Honey-wood playback controls panel:
  * **Previous Track** (purple button, `< 3s` restarts track, otherwise previous in queue).
  * **Play / Pause** (large prominent green button).
  * **Next Track** (amber button, advances active queue).
  * **Repeat Mode** (pink button with loop indicator dot).
* **"More Rhymes"** ivory pill button returning to the library.

#### Favorites & Settings ([`FavoritesView.swift`](file:///home/agent/workspace/NurseryRhymes/NurseryRhymes/Views/FavoritesView.swift) & [`SettingsView.swift`](file:///home/agent/workspace/NurseryRhymes/NurseryRhymes/Views/SettingsView.swift))
* Dedicated Favorites tab supporting playback from the favorites queue, with an empty state and "Explore Rhymes" action.
* Settings modal providing toggles for **Autoplay Next Rhyme**, **Continuous Repeat**, **Sound Effects**, **Reduce Animations** (also respecting system `accessibilityReduceMotion`), **Reset Saved Favorites** (with confirmation), and app version details.
